allies.name: Ratna
allies.role: Nurse at Tirta Husada Mental Hospital
allies.want: Patients going home safely and being accepted by their neighbors
allies.fear: People with mental illness being treated roughly on the street
talk: One hot tea, please. I just finished the evening shift.
I work at the mental hospital across the road. Don't worry, our patients are fine.
If you meet someone confused on the street, just greet them softly. Don't shout.
The nasi kucing is just right before a night shift.
A patient wandered off yesterday. Luckily the neighbors helped look for him instead of hitting him.
I'm glad there's an angkringan near here. A place to talk after a shift.
You're a patient person. You'd fit right in on the ward, haha.
If anyone needs help, call me. Our ambulance is on standby.
I saved your cart's number. The other nurses like to stop by too.
People with mental illness are sick, not bad. You already understand that.
Wherever your cart is, if I pass by, I'll stop.
If someone needs help while I'm here, let our team handle it.

favoriteHints.teh_hangat: Something warm, just a little sweet. To get my energy back after the shift.
favoriteHints.nasi_kucing: The small one wrapped in a leaf, to fill me up before the night shift.
favoriteHints.wedang_jahe: Something spicy-warm for my throat. The ward was freezing today.

allies.name: Officer Bram
allies.role: Police officer at headquarters, loves strong coffee
allies.want: Small vendors being able to sell in peace
allies.fear: People being too scared to report extortion
talk: Hot coffee, no sugar.
I'm stationed at headquarters. Just stopping by before the night roll call.
Has anyone asked you for protection money here? Don't keep paying, or they'll keep coming back.
The satay is good. Don't tell my commander I come here so often.
Keep your trading permit safe. That's what you show when someone tries something.
My father was a vendor too. I know how hard it is.
You're brave. Most vendors choose to stay quiet.
If someone extorts you, note what they look like. We'll follow up.
I told the officers on duty to keep an eye on this angkringan.
Your coffee keeps me awake until dawn.
Wherever you're selling, if I see your cart, I'll stop.
If someone tries to extort you while I'm having coffee, leave it to me.

favoriteHints.kopi_panas: Black, hot, no sugar. Keeps me awake until roll call.
favoriteHints.sate_usus: The one on a skewer, grilled. Not the sweet kind.
favoriteHints.tempe_goreng: The simplest fried snack. What students in boarding houses eat.
